messages.author: c027a0d4ee83ac1a
messages.subject: removing  individuals and markers with lots of missing data
parts:
Hi Karl,
I am new to R/QTL and pardon my asking. I am working on days to flowering (DTF) and other agronomic traits with a  RIL population(sorghum). 
My data consists of 139 individuals and over 11000 markers. I am trying to clean up my data by removing markers and individuals with missing data.
After running the code I got a warning message
 Error in drop.markers(DTF, to drop) : 
You're attempting to drop *all* of the markers, which isn't allowed.

Can you please help me figure out what I am doing wrong . I will be delighted if you can help me.

Best regards
Price

#Plot missing data
plotMissing(DTF)
ntyped(DTF) #provides numbers of genotyped markers for each individual
#OR
nmissing(DTF) #provides number of missing genotypes for each individual or marker

par(mfrow=c(1,2), las=1)
plot(ntyped(DTF), ylab = "No. typed markers", main = "No. genotypes by individual")
plot(ntyped(DTF, "mar"), ylab = "No. typed individuals",  main = "No. genotypes by marker")

#removing missing data
DTF<- subset(DTF, ind=(ntyped(DTF)>50))# omit individuals with lots of missing genotype data
nt.bymar<- ntyped(DTF,"mar")
todrop<- names(nt.bymar[nt.bymar<200])
DTF<- drop.markers(DTF,todrop)

On May 8, 2020, at 7:00 AM, price akiina <akiin...@gmail.com> wrote:

﻿
Hi Karl,
I am new to R/QTL and pardon my asking. I am working on days to flowering (DTF) and other agronomic traits with a  RIL population(sorghum). 
My data consists of 139 individuals and over 11000 markers. I am trying to clean up my data by removing markers and individuals with missing data.
After running the code I got a warning message
 Error in drop.markers(DTF, to drop) : 
You're attempting to drop *all* of the markers, which isn't allowed.

Can you please help me figure out what I am doing wrong . I will be delighted if you can help me.

Best regards
Price

#Plot missing data
plotMissing(DTF)
ntyped(DTF) #provides numbers of genotyped markers for each individual
#OR
nmissing(DTF) #provides number of missing genotypes for each individual or marker

par(mfrow=c(1,2), las=1)
plot(ntyped(DTF), ylab = "No. typed markers", main = "No. genotypes by individual")
plot(ntyped(DTF, "mar"), ylab = "No. typed individuals",  main = "No. genotypes by marker")

#removing missing data
DTF<- subset(DTF, ind=(ntyped(DTF)>50))# omit individuals with lots of missing genotype data
nt.bymar<- ntyped(DTF,"mar")
todrop<- names(nt.bymar[nt.bymar<200])
DTF<- drop.markers(DTF,todrop)
